value.rationale: The standard truncated tetrahedral Archimedean graph is a canonical natural 12-vertex cubic graph. Its two-independence complex has a mixed 3/4-dimensional integral sphere wedge despite a nonpure 3/5-dimensional facet profile. The mismatch gives a substantive nonpure-shellability obstruction, beyond simple face counts or a known-table recomputation.
